name: Cron Horizon
target_user: Developers, DevOps engineers, and system administrators.
problem: Cron expressions are hard to read, debug, and predict, leading to unexpected job execution times or resource-heavy overlaps.
pain: Setting up a cron expression and accidentally triggering a heavy script every minute instead of every hour, or having two resource-intensive jobs run simultaneously and crash the server.
solution: A local-first cron visualizer that parses standard cron syntax, generates an interactive 12-month calendar projection, and flags potential concurrency conflicts.
verification: Paste a specific cron expression (e.g., '*/15 9-17 * * 1-5'), verify that the generated run-times list matches expected 15-minute intervals during business hours on weekdays.
major_features: Confrontation detector for overlapping schedule configurations
Human-readable natural language translation of cron syntax
